title: Silver vs gold for your skin tone: how to choose
description: Silver or gold for your skin tone? Find your undertone with three quick tests, see which metal tends to flatter it, and learn when to ignore the rules entirely.
keywords: silver vs gold for skin tone
does silver or gold suit me
intro: Whether silver or gold suits you depends more on your skin's undertone than on how fair or dark you are. Cool undertones often glow with silver, warm undertones often light up with gold, and neutral undertones can wear both easily. These are guidelines, though, not rules. Your wardrobe and personal taste matter just as much.

sections.heading: Skin tone vs undertone
paragraphs: Skin tone is the surface colour, from very fair to very deep. Undertone is the subtle hue underneath it, and it stays the same even when you tan in summer. Two people with the same skin tone can have different undertones, which is why the same necklace can look brilliant on one and slightly flat on the other.
Indian skin spans a huge range of tones, and many people have warm or neutral undertones, but cool undertones are common too. Do not assume anything based on how light or dark your skin is. Test it.

sections.heading: Three quick tests to find your undertone
paragraphs: Do these in natural daylight, near a window, without makeup.
list: Vein test: look at the veins on the inside of your wrist. Mostly blue or purple suggests cool. Mostly greenish suggests warm. A mix, or hard to tell, often means neutral.
White cloth test: hold a bright white cloth and then an off-white or cream one near your face. If bright white flatters you more, you may be cool. If cream looks better, you may be warm.
Metal test: hold a silver piece against your wrist, then a gold one. Notice which makes your skin look clearer and more even, and which makes it look tired or sallow.

sections.heading: If you have cool undertones
paragraphs: Silver, white gold and rhodium finishes tend to look crisp and fresh on cool undertones. Bright white CZ stones, blues, purples and emerald greens usually work beautifully alongside silver.

That does not rule out gold. Rose gold, which has a pinkish tint, often suits cool skin better than very yellow gold. If you love yellow gold, wear it a little away from the face, such as on the wrist, and keep silver near the face.

sections.heading: If you have warm undertones
paragraphs: Yellow gold usually brings out the warmth in your skin and looks rich. Warm stone colours like red, orange, champagne and amber pair well. Traditional Kundan and Polki-look sets, which sit in gold tones, often suit warm undertones naturally, which is one reason they feel so right at Indian weddings.
You can still wear silver. Gold plated silver is a neat way to get the warm tone you like on a silver base, and a silver piece with warm-toned stones balances things out.

sections.heading: If you are neutral
paragraphs: Neutral undertones are the luckiest here. Both silver and gold usually look good, and so do pieces that mix the two. You can choose based on your outfit, your watch, or simply your mood that day. Two-tone jewellery and layered stacks of mixed metals tend to look especially natural on neutral skin.

sections.heading: When to ignore all of this
paragraphs: Undertone advice is a helpful starting point, not a dress code. A few things can matter more:
list: Your wardrobe: if you wear a lot of black, grey, white and denim, silver often fits your style better regardless of undertone.
Your existing jewellery: if your mangalsutra, watch or everyday earrings are gold, matching them may matter more to you than undertone.
Hair colour: silver or grey hair often pairs beautifully with silver jewellery.
The occasion: festive Indian outfits often call for gold tones, while minimal western outfits often suit silver.
Personal joy: if you love wearing a metal, wear it confidently. That shows more than any undertone.

sections.heading: Trying both before you commit
paragraphs: If you are still unsure, start with one silver and one gold-toned piece of similar design and wear each for a week. Notice which one you reach for and which gets compliments. Varaha's [925 silver pendants](/silver) come in both plain silver and gold plated finishes, so you can compare a similar style in both tones. For festive gold-toned looks, the [Kundan necklace sets](/women/necklaces) are another way to see how gold sits against your skin.

faq.a: It can, beautifully. Undertone matters more than depth of skin tone. Many people with dusky skin and cool or neutral undertones look striking in silver.

faq.q: How do I know if I have warm or cool undertones?
faq.a: Check your wrist veins in daylight. Blue or purple suggests cool, green suggests warm, and a mix suggests neutral.

faq.q: Can I wear silver and gold together?
faq.a: Yes. Mixing metals is common now, especially if you have a neutral undertone. A two-tone piece helps tie them together.
